title: First public publication of Engram project memories on engram-data, after a full-history content review
outcome: First public publication of Engram project memories on engram-data, after a full-history content review
acceptance: Every published memory revision, current and historical, has been content-reviewed for secrets, credentials and private personal data, and the review's verdicts are recorded

Content that cannot be published safely is withheld or redacted without carrying the original text forward (a revision does not erase earlier bodies, so a key needing redaction is re-created under a new key and the old key forgotten), with references updated

Central exports with --include-memories onto engram-data, the commit is pushed fast-forward-only after the pre-push privacy check, and DL560 imports it with no key refused, or each refusal is recorded with its reason

completion.summary: First public publication of Engram project memories is done. Content review covered all 108 current bodies and 1,678 history-only lines; two keys were re-created without a private link and third-party details and the old keys forgotten (body-free tombstones). Central exported tasks+memories (236 keys, 0 withheld, notes off) as engram-data b4f0025d, pushed fast-forward from bb683f0c after a clean disclosure check. DL560 got engram 50862fce (backup kept, all 4 stores ready) and imported b4f0025d: 54 task changes and 236 memory records applied, 0 refused; 108 current keys on both hosts. Independent evaluation (session-18297) passed 3/3.
